# A 200.00 USD invoice for C-US whose grouped payment block applies two splits
# of one transaction: a credit an unpost handed back, and a settlement a bank
# paid that another unpost loosened.
#
# Imported after `fx_invoice_usd_overpaid_into_usd_bank.txt`, whose 100.00 USD
# credit `fx_invoice_auto_applying_the_whole_credit.txt` spent whole.
# `unpost-invoices INV-USD-AUTO` hands the credit back, carrying
# `applied_from_credit`, and here a cost basis balance stated with
# `--strategy update`. `unpost-invoices INV-USD-OVER` loosens that invoice's own
# settlement. The test puts the transaction's guid in place of TXN_GUID, the
# settlement's in place of SETTLEMENT_GUID and the credit's in place of
# CREDIT_GUID.
#
# What this fixture produces: INV-USD-G settled by both splits. The credit keeps
# `applied_from_credit` and its cost and gives up its cost basis balance, and
# the settlement is not recorded as credit.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_a_grouped_payment_spending_a_handed_back_credit_takes_its_balance_off.py.
invoice "INV-USD-G"
	customer_id: "C-US"
	currency: USD
	date_opened: 2026-03-10
	entry:
		date: 2026-03-10
		description: "Grouped"
		action: "Hours"
		account: "Income:Sales"
		quantity: 1
		price: 200
		taxable: false
		tax_included: false
	posted:
		date: 2026-03-10
		due: 2026-04-10
		ar_account: "Assets:Accounts Receivable USD"
		memo: "Invoice INV-USD-G"
		accumulate: true
	payment:
		date: 2026-03-10
		amount: 200
		account: "Assets:Bank:USD"
		Transaction "TXN_GUID"
			PaymentSplit "SETTLEMENT_GUID"
			PaymentSplit "CREDIT_GUID"
